697	  /*
698	   * This method should take an equality formula and produce
699	   * the principal unifier.
700	   */
701	  
702	  
703	  def unify(e: EFormula)(implicit ta: TypeAnalyzer): Option[(Type => Type, Op => Op, IntExpr => IntExpr)] =
704	    un(reduce(e))
705	  
706	  private def un(e: EFormula)(implicit ta: TypeAnalyzer): Option[(Type => Type, Op => Op, IntExpr => IntExpr)] = { // println("un of " + e)
707	   e match {
708	    case False => None
709	    case True => Some((tEmptySub, oEmptySub, nEmptySub))
710	    case e@Conjuncts(teq, oeq, neq) =>
711	      // Makes sure we don't have to use fixed point types
712	      def tError(x: (Set[_InferenceVarType], Set[Type])) = x match {
713	        case (a, b) => b.flatMap(TU.getInferenceVars).exists(a.contains(_))
714	      }
715	      // Takes a set of more than one inference variable and creates a substitution to unify them
716	      def tMake(x: Set[_InferenceVarType]) = tSubstitution({ val result = Map(x.tail.map((x.head, _)).toSeq:_*); // println("tMake subst = " + result);
717	                                                             result })
718	      val (mTSub, tSplit, tVars, tReg) = makeSub(teq, tError, tMake).getOrElse(return None)
719	      // No errors possible
720	      def oError(x: (Set[_InferenceVarOp], Set[Op])) = false
721	      def oMake(x: Set[_InferenceVarOp]) = oSubstitution(Map(x.tail.map((x.head, _)).toSeq:_*)) 
722	      val (mOSub, oSplit, oVars, oReg) = makeSub(oeq, oError, oMake).getOrElse(return None)
723	      // No errors possible for sizes either
724	      def nError(x: (Set[_InferenceVarInt], Set[IntExpr])) = false
725	      def nMake(x: Set[_InferenceVarInt]) = nSubstitution(Map(x.tail.map((x.head, _)).toSeq:_*))
726	      val (mNSub, nSplit, nVars, nReg) = makeSub(neq, nError, nMake).getOrElse(return None)
727	      // Combine op and type substitutions
728	      val mTOSub = (mTSub, mOSub) match {
729	        case (Some(tSub), Some(oSub)) => Some((insertOps(oSub) compose tSub, oSub))
730	        case (Some(tSub), None) => Some((tSub, oEmptySub))
731	        case (None, Some(oSub)) => Some((insertOps(oSub), oSub))
732	        case (None, None) => None
733	      }
734	      // and the size substitution with those
735	      val mTONSub = (mTOSub, mNSub) match {
736	        case (Some((tSub, oSub)), Some(nSub)) => Some((insertNats(nSub) compose tSub, oSub, nSub))
737	        case (Some((tSub, oSub)), None) => Some((tSub, oSub, nEmptySub))
738	        case (None, Some(nSub)) => Some((insertNats(nSub), oEmptySub, nSub))
739	        case (None, None) => None
740	      }
741	      mTONSub match{
742	        case Some((tSub, oSub, nSub)) =>
743		  val eResult = eMap(e, tSub, oSub, nSub)
744	//	  println("un recursion 1: eMap produces " + eResult)
745	          // If there were any inference variables to be unified, then recurse
746	          un(eResult).map{case (t, o, n) => (t compose tSub, o compose oSub, n compose nSub)}
747	        case None=>
748		  /* Gets all equivalence classes with more than two non inference variable types and computes the 
749		   * constraints under which they are equivalent.
750		   */
751		  val tNewCons = tReg.filter{_.size > 1}.map{e => e.tail.foldLeft((e.head, True.asInstanceOf[EFormula]))
752		    {case ((s, c), t) => (t, and(c, getEquality(ta.equivalent(s, t))))}._2}
753		  if(!tNewCons.isEmpty) {
754		    // If there were any new constraints, then recurse
755		    val tNewCon = and(tNewCons)
756		    val tOrig = Conjuncts(tSplit.map{case (iv, niv) => iv ++ Set(niv.head)}, oeq, neq)
757		    un(and(tNewCon, tOrig))
758		  } else {
759		    /* Now each equivalence class must consist of one inference variable 
760		     * and one non inference variable. Unify them.
761		     */
762		    // A size class holds at most one size, a static parameter or a literal
763		    if (nSplit.exists{case (_, ns) => removeDups(ns, nEq).size > 1 || ns.exists(!isNatTerm(_))})
764		      return None
765		    val tSub = tSubstitution(Map(tSplit.map{case (iv, ts) => (iv.head, ts.head)}.toSeq:_*))
766		    val oSub = oSubstitution(Map(oSplit.map{case (iv, ts) => (iv.head, ts.head)}.toSeq:_*))
767		    val nSub = nSubstitution(Map(nSplit.filter{case (iv, ns) => !iv.isEmpty && !ns.isEmpty}.
768		                                        map{case (iv, ns) => (iv.head, ns.head)}.toSeq:_*))
769		    Some((insertNats(nSub) compose insertOps(oSub) compose tSub, oSub, nSub))
770	          }
771	      }
772	    case Disjuncts(es) =>
773	      for(e <- es) {
774	        val solved = un(e)
775	        if(solved.isDefined) return solved
776	      }
777	      None
778	  } }

780	  // Have to use a manifest due to erasure
781	  private def makeSub[T, U <: T](xss: Set[Set[T]], error: ((Set[U], Set[T])) => Boolean , makeS: Set[U] => (T => T))(implicit m: scala.reflect.Manifest[U]): Option[(Option[T => T], Set[(Set[U], Set[T])], Set[Set[U]], Set[Set[T]])] = {
782	    val split = xss.map{_.partition(m.erasure.isInstance(_))}.asInstanceOf[Set[(Set[U], Set[T])]]
783	    if(split.exists(error))
784	      None
785	    else {
786	      val (us, ts) = split.unzip
787	      Some(us.filter{_.size > 1}.map(makeS).reduceRightOption((a, b) => a compose b), split, us, ts)
788	    }
789	  }

791	  def cMap(form: CFormula, tSub: Type => Type = tEmptySub, oSub: Op => Op = oEmptySub,
792	           nSub: IntExpr => IntExpr = nEmptySub)(implicit ta: TypeAnalyzer): CFormula = 
793	    cMapWithDebug(form, tSub, oSub, nSub, false)

795	  def cMapWithDebug(form: CFormula, tSub: Type => Type, oSub: Op => Op, nSub: IntExpr => IntExpr, debug:Boolean)(implicit ta: TypeAnalyzer): CFormula =
796	  {
797	    if (debug)
798	      println("cMap("+form+", "+tSub+", "+oSub+", "+nSub+")")
799	    form match {
800	    case And(ts, os, ns) =>
801	      val tForm = and(ts.map{
802	        case (k, TPrimitive(pl,nl,pu,nu,pe,ne)) =>
803	          val sk = tSub(k)
804	  	  if (debug)
805	  	    println("cMap substitutes " + sk + " for " + k)
806		  val plf = ta.subtype(tSub(ta.join(pl)), sk)
807		  val nlf = and(nl.map(t => ta.notSubtype(tSub(t),sk)))
808		  val puf = ta.subtype(sk, tSub(ta.meet(pu)))
809		  val nuf = and(nu.map(t => ta.notSubtype(sk, tSub(t))))
810		  val pef = and(pe.map(t => ta.excludes(sk,tSub(t))))
811		  val nef = and(ne.map(t => ta.notExcludes(sk, tSub(t))))
812		  if (debug)
813		    println("cMap produces AND(" + plf + "," + nlf + "," + puf + "," + nuf + "," + pef + "," + nef + ")")
814	          and(plf, and(nlf, and(puf, and(nuf, and(pef, nef)))))})
815	      val oForm = and(os.map{
816	        case (k, OPrimitive(po, no)) =>
817	          val sk = oSub(k)
818	          and(and(po.map(ta.equivalent(sk, _))), and(no.map(ta.notEquivalent(sk, _))))
819	      })
820	      val nForm = and(ns.map{
821	        case (k, NPrimitive(pn, nn)) =>
822	          val sk = nSub(k)
823	          and(and(pn.map(e => ta.equivalent(sk, nSub(e)))), and(nn.map(e => ta.notEquivalent(sk, nSub(e)))))
824	      })
825	      and(and(tForm, oForm), nForm)
826	    case Or(cs) => dis(cs.map(cMap(_, tSub, oSub, nSub)))
827	    case _ => form
828	  }
829	  }
830	  def eMap(form: EFormula, tSub: Type => Type = tEmptySub, oSub: Op => Op = oEmptySub,
831	           nSub: IntExpr => IntExpr = nEmptySub)(implicit ta: TypeAnalyzer): EFormula = form match {
832	    case Conjuncts(ts, os, ns) => reduce(Conjuncts(ts.map(_.map(tSub)), os.map(_.map(oSub)), ns.map(_.map(nSub))))
833	    case Disjuncts(es) => dis(es.map(eMap(_, tSub, oSub, nSub)))
834	    case _ => form
835	  }

837	  def negate(c: CFormula)(implicit ta: TypeAnalyzer): CFormula = neg(reduce(c))
838	  
839	  def neg(c: CFormula)(implicit ta: TypeAnalyzer): CFormula = c match {
840	    case True => False
841	    case False => True
842	    case Or(cs) => and(cs.map(negate))
843	    case And(ts, os, ns) =>
844	      def tNeg(ip: (_InferenceVarType, TPrimitive)): CFormula = ip match {
845	        case (i, TPrimitive(pl, nl, pu, nu, pe, ne)) =>
846	          or(or(pl.map(notLowerBound(i, _))), or(
847	             or(nl.map(lowerBound(i, _))), or(
848	             or(pu.map(notUpperBound(i, _))), or(
849	             or(nu.map(upperBound(i, _))), or(
850	             or(pe.map(notExclusion(i, _))),
851	             or(ne.map(exclusion(i, _))))))))
852	      }
853	      def oNeg(ip: (_InferenceVarOp, OPrimitive)): CFormula = ip match {
854	        case (i, OPrimitive(po, no)) =>
855	          or(or(po.map(oNotEquivalent(i, _))), or(no.map(oEquivalent(i, _))))
856	      }
857	      def nNeg(ip: (_InferenceVarInt, NPrimitive)): CFormula = ip match {
858	        case (i, NPrimitive(pn, nn)) =>
859	          or(or(pn.map(nNotEquivalent(i, _))), or(nn.map(nEquivalent(i, _))))
860	      }
861	      or(or(or(ts.map(tNeg)), or(os.map(oNeg))), or(ns.map(nNeg)))
862	  }

864	  def upperBound(i: _InferenceVarType, t: Type): CFormula =
865	    And(Map(i -> TPrimitive(Set(), Set(), Set(t), Set(), Set(), Set())), Map())
866	  
867	  def notUpperBound(i: _InferenceVarType, t: Type): CFormula = 
868	    And(Map(i -> TPrimitive(Set(), Set(), Set(), Set(t), Set(), Set())), Map())
869	  
870	  def lowerBound(i: _InferenceVarType, t: Type): CFormula =
871	    And(Map(i -> TPrimitive(Set(t), Set(), Set(), Set(), Set(), Set())), Map())

102	  protected def pSub(x: Type, y: Type)(implicit negate: Boolean, history: Set[hType]): CFormula = {

104	     val indentation = indentationPadding.take(savedDepthForPrinting % indentationPadding.size)
105	     if (debugSubtype) {
106	//         System.err.println(indentation + "psub > (" + x.getClass + "!" + x + ", " + y.getClass + "!" + y + ", " + negate + "), history=" + history)
107	//         System.err.println(indentation + "psub > (" + x.getClass + "!" + x + ", " + y.getClass + "!" + y + ", " + negate + "), env=" + env)
108	         System.err.println(indentation + "psub > (" + x + ", " + y + ", " + negate + "), env=" + env)
109	         pSubDepthForPrinting += 1
110		 if (pSubDepthForPrinting > 50) bug(x, "pSub stack getting too big!")
111	     }
112	     val rval = if (x == y)
113	           pTrue()
114	         else if (cacheSubtypes && !opensSizes(x))
115	           traits.groundAnswer(true, x, y, negate) match {
116	            case null => pSubMemo.get((x, y, negate, history)) match {
117	              case Some(v) => traits.readContext(); v
118	              case _ =>
119	                val before = traits.contextReads
120	                val result = pSubInner(x,y)
121	                pSubMemo += ((x, y, negate, history) -> result)
122	                traits.ground(true, x, y, negate, before, result)
123	                result
124	            }
125	            case v => v
126	           }
127	         else pSubInner(x,y)
128	     if (debugSubtype) {
129	         System.err.println(indentation + "psub < (" + x + ", " + y + ", " + negate + ") RETURNS " + rval)
130	         pSubDepthForPrinting = savedDepthForPrinting
131	     }
132	     rval
133	  }

135	  protected def pSubInner(x: Type, y: Type)(implicit negate: Boolean, history: Set[hType]): CFormula = (x, y) match {
136	    // case (s,t) if (s==t) => pTrue() // moved up before cache for speed
137	    case (s: BottomType, _) => pTrue()
138	    case (s, t: AnyType) => pTrue()
139	    // Intersection types
140	    case (s, SIntersectionType(_,ts)) =>
141	      pAnd(ts.map(pSub(s, _)))  
142	    // An intersection bounds an inference variable from below as a whole
143	    case (s: IntersectionType, t: _InferenceVarType) => pLowerBound(t, s)
144	    case (SIntersectionType(_,ss), t) => {
145	//       val specialTerm =
146	//         if (ss.size > 0 && ss.exists(!_.isInstanceOf[ArrowType])) pTrue()
147	//         else pSub(NF.makeArrowType(NU.getSpan(x),
148	// 				   NF.makeIntersectionType(toJavaSet(ss.map(_.asInstanceOf[ArrowType].getDomain))),
149	// 				   NF.makeUnionType(toJavaSet(ss.map(_.asInstanceOf[ArrowType].getRange)))),
150	//                   t)
151	//       pOr(pOr(pOr(ss.map(pSub(_, t))), specialTerm),
152	//           pOr(Pairs.distinctPairsFrom(ss).map(tt => pExc(tt._1, tt._2)))) // The second constraint is the only time exclusion is called during subtype checking
153	      pOr(pOr(ss.map(pSub(_, t))),
154	          pOr(Pairs.distinctPairsFrom(ss).map(tt => pExc(tt._1, tt._2)))) // The second constraint is the only time exclusion is called during subtype checking
155	    }
156	    // Union types
157	    case (SUnionType(_,ss), t) =>
158	      pAnd(ss.map(pSub(_, t)))
159	    case (s: TraitType, t@SUnionType(_, ts)) =>
160	      val unionResult = pOr(ts.map(pSub(s, _)))
161	      comprisedTypes(s) match {
162	        case Some(cs) => pOr(unionResult, pAnd(cs.map(pSub(_, t)))) 
163	        case None => unionResult
164	      }
165	    case (s, SUnionType(_, ts)) =>
166	      pOr(ts.map(pSub(s, _)))
167	    // We must eliminate trait self types before making constraints  
168	    case (s: TraitSelfType, t) => pSub(removeSelf(s), t)
169	    case (s, STraitSelfType(_, named, _)) => pSub(s,named)
170	    // Inference variables
171	    case (s: _InferenceVarType, t: _InferenceVarType) =>
172	      pAnd(pUpperBound(s, t), pLowerBound(t,s))
173	    case (s: _InferenceVarType, t) => pUpperBound(s,t)
174	    case (s, t: _InferenceVarType) => pLowerBound(t,s)
175	    /* Type variables are special for several reasons
176	     *  1) Getting the bound out of a type variable is the only place where a type can increase in size during type checking.
177	     *     We use the history to ensure termination.
178	     *  2) They are the only place where you cannot negate using de Morgan's. There is a good explanation of why in the OOPSLA paper.
179	     */
180	    case (s@SVarType(_, sid, _), t@SVarType(_, tid, _)) if (sid == tid 
181	        // || sid.asInstanceOf[Id].getText == tid.asInstanceOf[Id].getText
182	        ) => True
183	            
184	    case (s@SVarType(_, id, _), t) =>
185	      val hEntry = (negate, true, s, t)
186	      traits.readContext()
187	      if (history.contains(hEntry)) {
188	        False
189	      } else {
190	        val nHistory = history + hEntry
191	        val sParam = staticParam(id)
192	
193	        def stdResult () =  {
194	          if (negate) {        
195	//	               println("pSubInner 0: FALSE")
196			       pFalse()(!negate)
197			     } else {
198			       // Using pNorm causes the current history to be passed down
199			       val supers = pNorm(makeIntersectionType(toListFromImmutable(sParam.getExtendsClause)))(nHistory)
200	//	               println("pSubInner 1: supers = " + supers)
201			       pSub(supers, t)(negate, nHistory)
202	                     }
203	        }
204	        
205	        val result = 
206	          if (t.isInstanceOf[VarType]) {
207	        	  val v = t.asInstanceOf[VarType].getName()
208	              val lowerParam = staticParam(v)
209	              if (!lowerParam.getDominatesClause().isEmpty()) { 
210	                val lowers = pNorm(makeUnionType(toListFromImmutable(lowerParam.getDominatesClause)))(nHistory)
211	                pSub(s,lowers)
212	              } else {stdResult()}
213	        } else {stdResult()} 
214	        
215	        
216	//	ErrorMsgMaker.printHashCodes = true
217	//	println("...and the result of the recursive pSub is " + result)
218	//	ErrorMsgMaker.printHashCodes = false
219	        result
220	      }
221	    case (s, t@SVarType(_, id, _)) =>
222	      val hEntry = (negate, true, s, t)
223	      traits.readContext()
224	      if (history.contains(hEntry))
225	        False
226	      else {
227	        val nHistory = history + hEntry
228	        val sParam = staticParam(id)
229	        val result = if (negate) {
230			       // Using pNorm causes the current history to be passed down
231			       val supers = pNorm(makeIntersectionType(toListFromImmutable(sParam.getExtendsClause)))(nHistory)
232	//	               println("pSubInner 2: supers = " + supers)
233			       pSub(s, supers)(negate, nHistory)
234			     } else {
235	//	               println("pSubInner 3: BOTTOM")
236			       pSub(s, BOTTOM)
237	                     }
238	//            ErrorMsgMaker.printHashCodes = true
239	//            println("...and the result of the recursive pSub is " + result)
240	//            ErrorMsgMaker.printHashCodes = false
241	        result
242	      }
243	    // Trait types
244	    case (s: TraitType, t: TraitType) if (t==OBJECT) => pTrue()
245	    
246	    case (STraitType(_,traitId_1,staticArgs_1,_),STraitType(_,traitId_2,staticArgs_2,_)) 
247	    	if (typeCons(traitId_1)==typeCons(traitId_2)) =>
248	
249	     // First, let's find the static parameters for trait traitId_1
250		  
251	     def same_id(idx: TypeConsIndex) = {
252	       traitId_1.getText().equals(idx.ast().asInstanceOf[TraitObjectDecl].getHeader().getName().asInstanceOf[Id].getText())
253	     }
254	
255	     val idx = traits.find(same_id)
256	     val staticParams = scalaify(idx.unwrap().staticParameters()).asInstanceOf[List[StaticParam]]
257	
258	     val args = staticParams.zip(staticArgs_1.zip(staticArgs_2))
259	     def cmp (param: StaticParam, args: (StaticArg,StaticArg)): CFormula = {
260	       if (param.getVariance() == 1)
261	         pSub(args._1.asInstanceOf[TypeArg].getTypeArg(),args._2.asInstanceOf[TypeArg].getTypeArg())
262	       else if (param.getVariance == -1)
263	         pSub(args._2.asInstanceOf[TypeArg].getTypeArg(),args._1.asInstanceOf[TypeArg].getTypeArg())
264	       else
265	         pEqv(args._1,args._2)
266	     }
267	     val formulas : List[CFormula] = args.map(e => cmp(e._1,e._2))
268	     pAnd(formulas)
269	    
270	    //case (STraitType(_, n1, a1,_), STraitType(_, n2, a2, _)) if (typeCons(n1)==typeCons(n2)) =>
271	      // println("checking " + a1 + " vs " + a2)
272	      //pAnd((a1, a2).zipped.map((a, b) => pEqv(a, b)))
273	    // A trait whose comprises clause lists a type at where-clause sizes, as
274	    // comprises { N[\n\] } where [\nat n\], is below t also when each listed
275	    // type is, its sizes opened: a value passed where N[\m\] is expected binds m
276	    // to its own size for that call.  A listed type extends the trait, so
277	    // the trait is opened once on each path.
278	    case (s: TraitType, t: TraitType) if opensSizes(s) =>
279	      val parentResult = pOr(parents(s).map(pSub(_, t)))
280	      val hEntry = (negate, true, s, t)
281	      traits.readContext()
282	      if (history.contains(hEntry)) parentResult
283	      else comprisedTypes(s) match {
284	        case Some(cs) => pOr(parentResult, pAnd(cs.map(pSub(_, t)(negate, history + hEntry))))
285	        case None => parentResult
286	      }
287	    case (s:TraitType , t: TraitType) =>
288	      // println("checking " + s + " <: " + t)
289	      val par = parents(s)
290	      // println(s + " has parents " + par)
291	      val parentResult = pOr(par.map(pSub(_, t)))
292	//       comprisedTypes(s) match {   // Gets a stack overflow error; maybe we don't need this in practice.  GLS 6/6/12
293	//         case Some(cs) => pOr(parentResult, pAnd(cs.map(c => parents(c.asInstanceOf[TraitType]).filter(!lteq(_,s)).map(pSub(_, t))).flatten))
294	//         case None => parentResult
295	//       }
296	      parentResult
297	    case (s: ObjectExprType, t) => pSub(removeSelf(s), t)
298	    // Arrow types
299	    case (SArrowType(_, d1, r1, e1, i1, _), SArrowType(_, d2, r2, e2, i2, _)) =>
300	      pAnd(pAnd(pSub(d2, d1), pSub(r1, r2)), pSub(e1, e2))
301	    // Tuple types
302	    // TODO: Handle keywords
303	    case (s@STupleType(_, e1, None, _), t@STupleType(_, e2, Some(mv2), _)) =>
304	      pSub(s, disjunctFromTuple(t, e1.size))
305	    case (s@STupleType(_, e1, Some(v1), _), t@STupleType(_, e2, _, _)) =>
306	      pAnd(pSub(disjunctFromTuple(s, e1.size), disjunctFromTuple(t, e1.size)),
307	           pSub(disjunctFromTuple(s, e2.size + 1), disjunctFromTuple(t, e2.size + 1)))
308	    case (s@STupleType(_, e1, None, _), t@STupleType(_, e2, None, _)) if e1.size == e2.size =>
309	      pOr(pOr(e1.map(pEqv(_, BOTTOM))), pAnd((e1,e2).zipped.map((a, b) => pSub(a, b))))
310	    case (s@STupleType(_, e1, _, _), t) =>
311	      pOr(e1.map(pEqv(_, BOTTOM)))
312	    case (s, t:TupleType) => 
313	      pSub(s, disjunctFromTuple(t,1))
314	    case _ => pFalse()
315	  }

417	  private val pExcMemo = new scala.collection.mutable.HashMap[(Type, Type, Boolean, Set[hType]), CFormula]()
418	    
419	  protected def pExc(x: Type, y: Type)(implicit negate: Boolean, history: Set[hType]): CFormula = {
420	    if (x == y) pFalse()
421	    else if (cacheExcludes)
422	      traits.groundAnswer(false, x, y, negate) match {
423	        case null => pExcMemo.get((x, y, negate, history)) match {
424	          case Some(v) => traits.readContext(); v
425	          case _ =>
426	            val before = traits.contextReads
427	            val result = pExcInner(x,y)
428	            pExcMemo += ((x, y, negate, history) -> result)
429	            traits.ground(false, x, y, negate, before, result)
430	            result
431	        }
432	        case v => v
433	      }
434	    else pExcInner(x,y)
435	  }
436	
437	  protected def pExcInner(x: Type, y: Type)(implicit negate: Boolean, history: Set[hType]): CFormula = (removeSelf(x), removeSelf(y)) match {
438	    case (s: BottomType, _) => pTrue()
439	    case (_, t: BottomType) => pTrue()
440	    case (s: AnyType, t) => pSub(t, BOTTOM)
441	    case (s, t: AnyType) => pSub(s, BOTTOM)
442	    case (s@SIntersectionType(_, elts), t) =>
443	      pOr(pSub(s, BOTTOM), pOr(elts.map(pExc(_, t))))
444	    case (s, t: IntersectionType) => exc(t, s)
445	    case (s@SUnionType(_, elts), t) =>
446	      pAnd(elts.map(pExc(_, t)))
447	    case (s, t: UnionType) => exc(t, s)
448	    case (i: _InferenceVarType, j: _InferenceVarType) if i==j => pFalse()
449	    case (i: _InferenceVarType, j: _InferenceVarType) => pAnd(pExclusion(i,j), pExclusion(j,i))
450	    case (i: _InferenceVarType, t) => pExclusion(i, t)
451	    case (s, j: _InferenceVarType) => pExc(j, s)
452	    case (s@SVarType(_, sid, _), t@SVarType(_, tid, _)) if (s==t || sid == tid) =>
453	      pOr(pSub(s, BOTTOM), pSub(t, BOTTOM))
454	    case (s@SVarType(_, id, _), t) =>
455	      val hEntry = (negate, false, s, t)
456	      traits.readContext()
457	      if (history.contains(hEntry))
458	        False
459	      else {
460	        val nHistory = history + hEntry
461	        val sParam = staticParam(id)
462	        val supers = pNorm(makeIntersectionType(toListFromImmutable(sParam.getExtendsClause)))
463	        if (negate) pFalse()(!negate) else pExc(supers, t)(negate, nHistory)
464	      }
465	    case (s, t:VarType) => exc(t, s)
466	    // TODO: Check what happens when stem s = stem t
467	    case (s: TraitType, t: TraitType) =>
468	      def checkEC(s: TraitType, t: TraitType): CFormula = {
469	        def cEC(s: TraitType, t: TraitType) = pOr(excludesClause(s).map(e => withClauseParams(e).pSub(t, e)))
470	        pOr(cEC(s, t), cEC(t, s))
471	      }
472	      def checkCC(s: TraitType, t: TraitType): CFormula = {
473	        def cCC(s: TraitType, t: TraitType): CFormula = {
474	          val scc = comprisesClause(s)
475	          pAnd(pFromBoolean(!scc.isEmpty), pAnd(scc.map(pExc(t,_))))
476	        }
477	        pOr(cCC(s, t), cCC(t, s))
478	      }
479	      def checkO(s: TraitType, t: TraitType): CFormula = {
480	        def cO(s: TraitType, t: TraitType): CFormula = typeCons(s.getName) match {
481	          case _:ObjectTraitIndex => pSub(s, t)(!negate, history)
482	          case _ => pFalse()
483	        }
484	        pOr(cO(s,t), cO(t,s))
485	      }
486	      def checkP(s: TraitType, t: TraitType): CFormula = {
487	        val sas = ancestors(s) ++ Set(s)
488	        val tas = ancestors(t) ++ Set(t)
489	        def cP(s: BaseType, t: BaseType): CFormula = (s, t) match {
490	          case (s@STraitType(_, n1, a1, _), t@STraitType(_, n2, a2, _)) if (n1 == n2) =>
491	            //Todo: Handle bool args
492	            pOr((a1, a2).zipped.map{
493	              case (STypeArg(_, _, t1), STypeArg(_, _, t2)) => pEqv(t1, t2)(!negate, history)
494	              case (SIntArg(_, _, i1: IntBase), SIntArg(_, _, i2: IntBase)) => pEqv(i1, i2)(!negate)
495	              case _ => pFalse()
496	            })
497	          case _ => pFalse()
498	        }
499	        pOr(for(sa <- sas; ta <- tas) yield cP(sa, ta))
500	      }
501	      pOr(List(checkEC(s,t), checkCC(s,t), checkO(s,t), checkP(s,t)))
502	    // ToDo: Handle keywords. Note that this will mean you can have a tuple of length 1 without varargs.
503	    case (s@STupleType(_, e1, Some(v1), _), t@STupleType(_, e2, mv2, _)) =>
504	        pExc(disjunctFromTuple(s, max(e1.size, e2.size)), t)
505	    case (s@STupleType(_, e1, None, _), t@STupleType(_, e2, Some(v2), _)) => pExc(t, s)
506	    case (STupleType(_, e1, None, _), STupleType(_, e2, None, _)) if (e1.size == e2.size) =>
507	      pOr((e1, e2).zipped.map((a, b) => pExc(a, b)))
508	    case (STupleType(_, e1, None, _), STupleType(_, e2, None, _)) =>
509	      pTrue()
510	    case (s: TupleType, t) => pExc(disjunctFromTuple(s, 1), t)
511	    case (s, t: TupleType) => pExc(t, s)
512	    case (s: ArrowType, t: ArrowType) => pFalse()
513	    case (s: ArrowType, t) => pTrue()
514	    case (s, t: ArrowType) => pExc(t, s)
515	  }

517	  protected def removeSelf(x: Type) = {
518	    object remover extends Walker {
519	      override def walk(y: Any): Any = y match {
520	        case t:TraitSelfType =>
521	          if (t.getComprised.isEmpty)
522	            t.getNamed
523	          else
524	            NF.makeIntersectionType(t.getNamed, NF.makeMaybeUnionType(t.getComprised))
525	        case t:ObjectExprType => NF.makeMaybeIntersectionType(t.getExtended)
526	        case _ => super.walk(y)
527	      }
528	    }
529	    remover(x).asInstanceOf[Type]
530	  }
531	  /*
532	   * For is-subtype queries, it makes no sense to stir in the comprised types;
533	   * if this is a subtype, then so are they
534	   * (unless they are declared to exclude -- but does that matter?) 
535	   */
536	  protected def removeSelfAsSubtype(x: Type) = {
537	    object remover extends Walker {
538	      override def walk(y: Any): Any = y match {
539	        case t:TraitSelfType => t.getNamed
540	        case t:ObjectExprType => NF.makeMaybeIntersectionType(t.getExtended)
541	        case _ => super.walk(y)
542	      }
543	    }
544	    remover(x).asInstanceOf[Type]
545	  }

548	  private val normalizeVarTypeMemo = new scala.collection.mutable.HashMap[Id, Any]()
549	  private val normalizeTraitTypeMemo = new scala.collection.mutable.HashMap[(Id, List[StaticArg]), Any]()
550	  private val normalizeTupleTypeMemo = new scala.collection.mutable.HashMap[(List[Type], Option[Type]), Any]()
551	  private val normalizeArrowTypeMemo = new scala.collection.mutable.HashMap[(Type, Type, Effect, Boolean), Any]()
552	  private val normalizeOtherTypeMemo = new scala.collection.mutable.HashMap[Any, Any]()
553	  // The normalize memos' keys whose value was computed by reading the context: a hit on one
554	  // is a read of the context too.
555	  private val contextualNorms = new scala.collection.mutable.HashSet[Any]()
556	  private def noteNorm(k: Any): Unit = if (contextualNorms.contains(k)) traits.readContext()
557	  private def markNorm(before: Long, ks: Any*): Unit = if (traits.contextReads != before) contextualNorms ++= ks
558	
559	  def normalize(x: Type): Type = pNorm(x)(Set[hType]())

561	  protected def pNorm(x: Type)(implicit history: Set[hType]): Type = {
562	    object normalizer extends Walker {
563	      override def walk(y: Any): Any = y match {
564	        case t: VarType => walkVarType(t)
565	        case t: TraitType => walkTraitType(t)
566	        case t: TupleType => walkTupleType(t)
567	        case t: ArrowType => walkArrowType(t)
568	        case _ => walkOtherType(y)
569	      }
570	      def walkVarType(t: VarType) = {
571	        t match { case SVarType(_, n, _) =>
572	            if (cacheNormalizeVar)
573	              normalizeVarTypeMemo.get(n) match {
574	                case Some(v) => noteNorm(n); v
575	                case _ =>
576	                  val before = traits.contextReads
577	                  val result = walkVarTypeInner(t, n)
578	                  normalizeVarTypeMemo += (n -> result)
579	                  markNorm(before, n)
580	                  result
581	              }
582	            else walkVarTypeInner(t, n)
583	        }
584	      }
585	      def walkVarTypeInner(t: VarType, n: Id) = super.walk(t)
586	      def walkTraitType(t: TraitType) = {
587	        t match { case STraitType(_, n, a, _) =>
588	            if (cacheNormalizeTrait) {
589	              normalizeTraitTypeMemo.get((n, a)) match {
590	                case Some(v) => noteNorm((n, a)); v
591	                case _ =>
592	                  val before = traits.contextReads
593	                  walkTraitTypeInner(t, n, a) match {
594	                    case result@STraitType(_, _, aa, _) =>
595	                       normalizeTraitTypeMemo += ((n, a) -> result)
596	                       normalizeTraitTypeMemo += ((n, aa) -> result)
597	                       markNorm(before, (n, a), (n, aa))
598	                       result
599	                  }
600	              }
601	            }
602	            else walkTraitTypeInner(t, n, a)
603	        }
604	      }
605	      def walkTraitTypeInner(t: TraitType, n: Id, a: List[StaticArg]) = {
606	        typeCons(n) match {
607	          case ti: TypeAliasIndex =>
608	            val params = toListFromImmutable(ti.staticParameters)
609	            walk(substitute(a, params, ti.ast.getTypeDef))
610	          case _ => super.walk(t)
611	        }
612	      }
613	      def walkTupleType(t: TupleType) = {
614	        if (cacheNormalizeTuple)
615	          t match { case STupleType(_, e, vt, _) =>
616	              normalizeTupleTypeMemo.get((e, vt)) match {
617	                case Some(v) => noteNorm((e, vt)); v
618	                case _ =>
619	                  val before = traits.contextReads
620	                  walkTupleTypeInner(t) match {
621	                    case result@STupleType(_, ee, vtx, _) =>
622	                      normalizeTupleTypeMemo += ((e, vt) -> result)
623	                      normalizeTupleTypeMemo += ((ee, vtx) -> result)
624	                      markNorm(before, (e, vt), (ee, vtx))
625	                      result
626	                    case result =>
627	                      normalizeTupleTypeMemo += ((e, vt) -> result)
628	                      markNorm(before, (e, vt))
629	                      result
630	                  }
631	              }
632	          }
633	        else walkTupleTypeInner(t)
634	      }
635	      def walkTupleTypeInner(t: TupleType) = {
636	        //ToDo: Handle keywords
637	        super.walk(t) match {
638	          case STupleType(i, e, Some(v: BottomType), k) => STupleType(i, e, None, k)
639	          case STupleType(i, e, vt, k) if e.contains(bottom) => bottom
640	          case STupleType(i, e, None, Nil) if (e.size == 1) => e.head
641	          case _ => t
642	        }
643	      }
644	      def walkArrowType(t: ArrowType) = {
645	        if (cacheNormalizeArrow)
646	          t match { case SArrowType(_, d, r, e, i, _) =>
647	              normalizeArrowTypeMemo.get((d, r, e, i)) match {
648	                case Some(v) => noteNorm((d, r, e, i)); v
649	                case _ =>
650	                  val before = traits.contextReads
651	                  walkArrowTypeInner(t) match {
652	                    case result@SArrowType(_, dd, rr, ee, ii, _) =>
653	                      normalizeArrowTypeMemo += ((d, r, e, i) -> result)
654	                      normalizeArrowTypeMemo += ((dd, rr, ee, ii) -> result)
655	                      markNorm(before, (d, r, e, i), (dd, rr, ee, ii))
656	                      result
657	                  }
658	              }
659	          }
660	        else walkArrowTypeInner(t)
661	      }
662	      def walkArrowTypeInner(t: ArrowType) = super.walk(t)
663	      def walkOtherType(t: Any) = {
664	        if (cacheNormalizeOther)
665	          normalizeOtherTypeMemo.get(t) match {
666	            case Some(v) => noteNorm(t); v
667	            case _ =>
668	              val before = traits.contextReads
669	              val result = walkOtherTypeInner(t)
670	              normalizeOtherTypeMemo += (t -> result)
671	              markNorm(before, t)
672	              result
673	          }
674	        else walkOtherTypeInner(t)
675	      }
676	      def walkOtherTypeInner(t: Any) = t match {
677	        case u@SUnionType(_, e) =>
678	          val ps = e.flatMap(t => disjuncts(walk(t).asInstanceOf[Type]))
679	          makeUnionType(normDisjunct(ps))
680	        case i@SIntersectionType(_, e) =>
681	          val sop = cross(e.map(t => disjuncts(walk(t).asInstanceOf[Type])))
682	          val ps = sop.map(t => makeIntersectionType(normConjunct(t.flatMap(disjuncts))))
683	          makeUnionType(normDisjunct(ps))
684	        case o:Op => normalize(o)
685	        case _ => super.walk(t)
686	      }
687	    }
688	    // Here's the body: walk the type, and make sure it's a type when finished
689	    normalizer(x).asInstanceOf[Type]
690	  }

692	  protected def normConjunct(x: Iterable[Type])(implicit history: Set[hType]): List[Type] = {
693	    val cc = x.map(y => (y, y.isInstanceOf[TraitType] &&
694	                            comprisesClause(y.asInstanceOf[TraitType]).exists(c => x.exists(z => dExc(z, c))))).toList
695	    if (cc.exists(_._2))
696	      cc.map(z => { val (y, p) = z;
697	                    if (p) makeUnionType(comprisesClause(y.asInstanceOf[TraitType]).toList.flatMap(c => if (x.exists(z => dExc(z, c))) None else Some(c)))
698	                    else y })
699	    else if (x.exists(y => x.exists(z => dExc(y, z))))
700	      List(BOTTOM)
701	    else {
702	      val ds = x.foldLeft(List[Type]())((l, a) => {
703	        val l2 = l.filter(x => !isTrue(sub(a, x)))
704	        l2 ++ (if (l2.exists(x => isTrue(sub(x, a)))) Nil else List(a))
705	      })
706	      val es = ds.map(_ match {
707	        case t:TupleType => Left(t)
708	        case s => Right(s)
709	      })
710	      val (ts, ss) = (for (Left(x) <- es) yield x, for (Right(x) <- es) yield x)
711	      ss ++ normTuples(ts)
712	    }
713	  }

715	  protected def normTuples(ts: List[TupleType])(implicit history: Set[hType]): List[TupleType] = ts match {
716	    case Nil => Nil
717	    case _ => List(ts.reduceLeft((a,b) => normTuples(a,b)))
718	  }

720	  //ToDo: Keywords
721	  protected def normTuples(x: TupleType, y: TupleType)(implicit history: Set[hType]): TupleType = (x,y) match {
722	    case (STupleType(_, e1, None, _), STupleType(_, e2, None, _)) =>
723	      STupleType(makeInfo(e1), (e1, e2).zipped.map((a,b) => pMeet(a,b)), None, Nil)
724	    case (STupleType(_, e1, None, _), STupleType(_, e2, Some(_), _)) =>
725	      normTuples(x, disjunctFromTuple(y, e1.size).asInstanceOf[TupleType])
726	    case (STupleType(_, e1, Some(_), _), STupleType(_, e2, None, _)) =>
727	      normTuples(disjunctFromTuple(x, e2.size).asInstanceOf[TupleType], y)
728	    case (STupleType(_, e1, Some(v1), _), STupleType(_, e2, Some(v2), _)) => {
729	      val ee1 = e1 ++ List.fill(e2.size - e1.size){v1}
730	      val ee2 = e2 ++ List.fill(e1.size - e2.size){v2}
731	      STupleType(makeInfo(e1), (ee1, ee2).zipped.map((a,b) => pMeet(a,b)), Some(pMeet(v1, v2)), Nil)
732	    }
733	  }

740	      })
741	      // println("normDisjunct:\n  " + x + "\n  " + result)
742	      result

772	  def comprisesClause(t: TraitType): Set[TraitType] = typeCons(t.getName) match {
773	    case ti: ProperTraitIndex =>
774	      val args = toListFromImmutable(t.getArgs)
775	      val params = toListFromImmutable(ti.staticParameters)
776	      toSet(ti.comprisesTypes).map(nt => if (!nt.isInstanceOf[TraitType]) return Set()
777	                                         else openWhereSizes(ti, substitute(args, params, nt)).asInstanceOf[TraitType])
778	    case _ => Set()
779	  }

781	  /* The nat and int where-clause variables of a trait declaration with a
782	   * comprises clause, as static parameters: comprises { N[\n\] } where
783	   * [\nat n\] lists N at every n. */
784	  def whereSizes(ti: ProperTraitIndex): List[StaticParam] =
785	    if (ti.comprisesTypes.isEmpty) Nil
786	    else ti.ast match {
787	      case d: TraitObjectDecl => toOption(NU.getWhereClause(d)) match {
788	        case Some(w) => toListFromImmutable(w.getBindings).filter(b =>
789	            b.getKind.isInstanceOf[KindNat] || b.getKind.isInstanceOf[KindInt]).map(b =>
790	            NF.makeStaticParam(NU.getSpan(b), null, b.getName,
791	                               _root_.java.util.Collections.emptyList[BaseType],
792	                               _root_.java.util.Collections.emptyList[BaseType],
793	                               none[Type], false, b.getKind))
794	        case None => Nil
795	      }
796	      case _ => Nil
797	    }

809	   * fresh name, equal only to itself (Formula.openedSizeName). */
810	  def openWhereSizes(ti: ProperTraitIndex, listed: Type): Type = whereSizes(ti) match {
811	    case Nil => listed
812	    case ws =>
813	      val opened = ws.map(p => NF.makeIntArg(NU.getSpan(p),
814	        NF.makeIntRef(NU.getSpan(p), NF.makeId(NU.getSpan(p), openedSizeName(p.getName.getText)))))
815	      substitute(opened, ws, listed)

832	  def comprisedTypes(t: TraitType): Option[Set[BaseType]] = {
833	    val STraitType(_, n, a, _) = t
834	    typeCons(n) match {
835	      case index: ProperTraitIndex =>
836		val cs = index.comprisesTypes
837		if (cs.isEmpty) None
838	        else
839		    Some(toSet(cs).map(typ => openWhereSizes(index, substitute(a, toListFromImmutable(index.staticParameters), typ)).asInstanceOf[BaseType]).toSet)
840	      case _ => None
841	    }
842	  }

844	  /* The analyzer in which a type an excludes clause names is read: a trait that excludes
845	   * another is added to the other's clause at its own static parameters
846	   * (IndexBuilder.checkTraitClauses), which are not in scope where that clause is read,
847	   * so the ones not in scope are added. */
848	  private def withClauseParams(e: TraitType): TypeAnalyzer = {
849	    val free = toListFromImmutable(e.getArgs).collect {
850	      case STypeArg(_, _, SVarType(_, n, _)) if { traits.readContext(); !env.contains(n) } => n.getText }
851	    if (free.isEmpty) this
852	    else typeCons(e.getName) match {
853	      case ti: TraitIndex =>
854	        val params = toListFromImmutable(ti.staticParameters).filter(p => free.contains(p.getName.getText))
855	        if (params.isEmpty) this else extend(params, None)
856	      case _ => this
857	    }

override def walk(node:Any):Any = {
    node match {
      // Static parameters and where-clause variables may be introduced.
      // To Do: Check for the where-clause variables.
      case STypeAlias(_, _, sparams, typeDef) =>
        val oldAnalyzer = analyzer
        analyzer = analyzer.extend(sparams, None)
        walk(typeDef)
        analyzer = oldAnalyzer
      case STraitDecl(_,
                      STraitTypeHeader(sparams, _, _, where,
                                       throwsC, contract, extendsC,
                                       params, decls),
                      self, excludes, comprises, _) =>
        val oldAnalyzer = analyzer
        analyzer = analyzer.extend(sparams, where)
        walk(sparams); walk(where); walk(throwsC); walk(contract); walk(extendsC)
        walk(params); walk(decls); walk(self); walk(excludes); walk(comprises)
        analyzer = oldAnalyzer
      case SObjectDecl(_,
                       STraitTypeHeader(sparams, _, _, where,
                                        throwsC, contract, extendsC,
                                        params, decls),
                       self) =>
        val oldAnalyzer = analyzer
        analyzer = analyzer.extend(sparams, where)
        walk(sparams); walk(where); walk(throwsC); walk(contract); walk(extendsC)
        walk(params); walk(decls); walk(self)
        analyzer = oldAnalyzer
      case SFnDecl(_,
              SFnHeader(sparams, _, _, where,
                  throwsC, contract, params, returnType),
                  _, body, _) =>
        val oldAnalyzer = analyzer
        analyzer = analyzer.extend(sparams, where)
        walk(sparams); walk(where); walk(throwsC); walk(contract); walk(params)
        walk(returnType); walk(body)
        analyzer = oldAnalyzer

    // Check the well-formedness of types.
      case _:AnyType => // OK
      case _:BottomType => // OK
      case t@SVarType(_, name, _) =>
      if ( ! analyzer.env.contains(name) )
        error("Unbound type: " + name, t)
      case t@STraitSelfType(_, named, tys) => walk(named); tys.foreach(walk)
      case t@SObjectExprType(_, tys) => tys.foreach(walk)
      case t@STraitType(_, name, sargs, _) =>
      getTypes(name) match {
        case si:TraitIndex => // Trait name should be defined.
        // Static arguments should satisfy the corresponding bounds.
        val sparams = si.staticParameters
        if ( sargs.size == sparams.size ) {
          sargs.zip(toListFromImmutable(sparams)).foreach { case (a, p) =>
            sizeOutOfRange(a, List(p.getKind)).foreach(m => error("Ill-formed type: " + t + "\n    " + m, t)) }
          val replacer = new StaticTypeReplacer(sparams, toJavaList(sargs))
          def wfStaticArgs(pair:(StaticArg,StaticParam)) =
            for ( bound <- toListFromImmutable(pair._2.getExtendsClause);
            if pair._1.isInstanceOf[TypeArg] ) {
              val new_bound = replacer.replaceIn(bound)
              if ( ! isTrue(analyzer.subtype(pair._1.asInstanceOf[TypeArg].getTypeArg,
                  new_bound))(analyzer))
                error("Ill-formed type: " + t +
                    "\n    The static argument " + pair._1 +
                    " does not satisfy the corresponding bound " + new_bound + ".", t)
            }
          sargs.zip(toListFromImmutable(sparams)).foreach(wfStaticArgs)
        } else error("Ill-formed type: " + t +
            "\n    The numbers of the static parameters and " +
            "the static arguments do not match.", t)
        case _ => error("Unbound type: " + name, t)
      }
      // Keyword parameters are not yet supported...
      case STupleType(_, elements, varargs, keywords) =>
      elements.foreach(walk)
      varargs match {
        case Some(ty) => walk(ty)
        case _ =>
      }
      // Effects are not yet supported...
      case SArrowType(_, domain, range, effect, io, _) => walk(domain); walk(range)
      case SIntersectionType(_, elements) => elements.foreach(walk)
      case SUnionType(_, elements) => elements.foreach(walk)
      case _:LabelType => // OK
      case _:DimBase => // OK
      case a:IntArg =>
        sizeOutOfRange(a, Nil).foreach(m => error("Ill-formed static argument: " + a + "\n    " + m, a))
      case SFunctionalRef(_, args, _, _, _, _, newOverloadings, _, schema) if !args.isEmpty =>
        val schemas = newOverloadings.flatMap(o => toOption(o.getSchema).toList) ++ schema.toList
        walkStaticArgs(args, kindsAt(schemas, args.size))
      case SFunctionalRef(_, args, _, _, _, _, _, _, _) =>
        // Only the static arguments are written at the reference site.  The two
        // overloading lists and the overloading type are assembled by overload
        // resolution out of the declared types of every functional of this name in
        // the environment, and a generic declaration contributes its own static
        // parameters free: they are not in this compilation unit's kind environment,
        // so checking them here either reports them unbound or fails the kind-env
        // lookup outright.  Each declaration is checked where it is declared.
        walk(args)
      case SMethodInvocation(_, getObj, getMethod, getStaticArgs, getArg, getOverloadingType, getOverloadingSchema) =>
        walk(getObj)
        walk(getMethod)
        walkStaticArgs(getStaticArgs, kindsAt(getOverloadingSchema.toList, getStaticArgs.size))
        walk(getArg)
        walk(getOverloadingType)
      case SOverloading(_, _, _, t, _) => walk(t)
        
      // Nodes with subnodes we want to ignore.
      case SCaseExpr(getInfo, getParam, getCompare, getEqualsOp, getInOp, getClauses, getElseClause) =>
      SCaseExpr(walk(getInfo).asInstanceOf[ExprInfo],
          walk(getParam).asInstanceOf[Option[Expr]],
          getCompare,
          getEqualsOp,
          getInOp,
          walk(getClauses).asInstanceOf[List[CaseClause]],
          walk(getElseClause).asInstanceOf[Option[Block]])

          /* Not yet implemented...
      case SFixedPointType(_, name, body) =>
      case STaggedDimType(_, elemType, dimExpr, unitExpr) =>
      case STaggedUnitType(_, elemType, unitExpr) =>
      case SDimRef(_, name) =>
      case SDimExponent(_, base, power) =>
      case SDimUnaryOp(_, dimVal, op) =>
      case SDimBinaryOp(_, left, right, op) =>
      */
      case _ => super.walk(node)
    }
    node
  }
}

trait Array3[\T, nat b0, nat s0, nat b1, nat s1, nat b2, nat s2\]
    extends { Indexed1[\s0\], Indexed2[\s1\], Indexed3[\s2\], Rank3,
              StandardMutableArrayType[\Array3[\T,b0,s0,b1,s1,b2,s2\],T,
                                        (ZZ32,ZZ32,ZZ32)\] }
    excludes { Number, String, AnyAdditiveGroup, AnyMultiplicativeRing }
    (* Excluding AnyAdditiveGroup picks one of two uses of rank 3.  An operator
       between an Array3 and a lower-rank array, such as a matrix added to every
       plane, can be declared without colliding with AdditiveGroup's
       +(self, other: T); in exchange no Array3 can be an additive group, a rank-3
       counterpart of Vector and Matrix.  Array1 and Array2 cannot exclude it:
       Vector and Matrix extend them and are additive groups. *)

    getter size():ZZ32 = s0 s1 s2
    getter sizes():(ZZ32,ZZ32,ZZ32) = (s0, s1, s2)
    getter bounds():CompactFullRange3D =
        sized3Range(b0,b1,b2,s0,s1,s2)

    getter asString():String = do
      r : String := "[" b0 "#" s0 "," b1 "#" s1 "," b2 "#" s2 "]"
      row(i: ZZ32, k: ZZ32) =
          for j <- seq(0#s1) do
            r := r " " self[b0+i,b1+j,b2+k]
          end
      plane(k: ZZ32) =
        if s1 > 0 then
          row(0,k)
          for i <- seq(1#(s0-1)) do
            r := r // " "
            row(i,k)
          end
        end
      if s0=0 then
        r "[]"
      else
        r := r // "["
        plane(0)
        for k <- seq(1#(s2-1)) do
          r := r " ;;" //  " "
          plane(k)
        end
        r " ]"
      end
    end

    opr |self| : ZZ32 = s0 s1 s2

    (* Again, offset performs bounds checking and shifts to 0 indexing. *)
    offset(t:(ZZ32,ZZ32,ZZ32)):(ZZ32,ZZ32,ZZ32) = do
      (a0,a1,a2)=t
      c0 = a0 - b0; c1 = a1 - b1; c2 = a2 - b2
      if NOT (0 <= c0 < s0) then oops(1, b0, s0, a0); end
      if NOT (0 <= c1 < s1) then oops(2, b1, s1, a1); end
      if NOT (0 <= c2 < s2) then oops(3, b2, s2, a2); end
      (c0,c1,c2)
    end
    toIndex(t:(ZZ32,ZZ32,ZZ32)):(ZZ32,ZZ32,ZZ32) =
        do (a0,a1,a2) = t; (a0+b0,a1+b1,a2+b2) end

    (* And get and put are 0-indexed without bounds checks. *)
    put(t:(ZZ32,ZZ32,ZZ32), v:T) : ()
    get(t:(ZZ32,ZZ32,ZZ32)):T

    opr[i:ZZ32, j:ZZ32, k:ZZ32] := (v:T): () = do self[ (i,j,k) ] := v end
    opr[r:Range[\(ZZ32,ZZ32,ZZ32)\]]: Array[\T,(ZZ32,ZZ32,ZZ32)\] = do
        r' = self.bounds.narrowToRange(r)
        (z0,z1,z2) = r'.extent.get
        (l0,l1,l2) = r'.left.get (*'*)
        (m0,m1,m2) = r'.stride (*'*)
        __subarray(self, N[\0\],reflect(z0), N[\0\],reflect(z1),
                   N[\0\],reflect(z2), reflect(l0),reflect(l1), reflect(l2),m0,m1,m2)
      end
    opr[_:TrivialOpenRange] : Array3[\T,0,s0,0,s1,0,s2\] =
        subarray[\0,s0,0,s1,0,s2,0,0,0\](1,1,1)
    shift(t:(ZZ32,ZZ32,ZZ32)): Array[\T,(ZZ32,ZZ32,ZZ32)\] = do
        (o0,o1,o2)=t
        if o0=0 AND o1=0 AND o2=0 then
            self
        else
            __subarray(self,
                       reflect(o0),N[\s0\], reflect(o1),N[\s1\],
                       reflect(o2),N[\s2\], N[\b0\],N[\b1\],N[\b2\],1,1,1)
        end
      end

    (** 3-D subarray given static subarray parameters.
        %(bo0,bo1,bo2)#(so0,so1,so2)% are output bounds.
        The result is the subarray starting at %(o0,o1,o2)% in the original array,
        striding by (m0,m1,m2).
     **)
    subarray[\nat bo0, nat so0, nat bo1, nat so1, nat bo2, nat so2,
              nat o0, nat o1, nat o2\]
            (m0:ZZ32,m1:ZZ32,m2:ZZ32): Array3[\T,bo0,so0,bo1,so1,bo2,so2\] = do
        boundsCheck = self.bounds.narrowToRange( (o0,o1,o2)::(m0,m1,m2)#(so0,so1,so2) )
        SubArray3[\T,bo0,so0,bo1,so1,bo2,so2,b0,s0,b1,s1,b2,s2\](self,m0,o0,m1,o1,m2,o2)
      end

    zeroIndices():CompactFullRange3D =
        sized3Range(0,0,0,s0,s1,s2)

    replica[\U\]():Array3[\U,b0,s0,b1,s1,b2,s2\] =
        __DefaultArray3[\U,b0,s0,b1,s1,b2,s2\]()
    copy():Array3[\T,b0,s0,b1,s1,b2,s2\] =
        self.replica[\T\]().tabulate(fn (i:ZZ32,j:ZZ32,k:ZZ32):T =>
                                         get(i-b0,j-b1,k-b2))
    map[\R\](f:T->R): Array3[\R,b0,s0,b1,s1,b2,s2\] =
        replica[\R\]().tabulate(fn (i:ZZ32,j:ZZ32,k:ZZ32):R =>
                                    f(get(i-b0,j-b1,k-b2)))
    ivmap[\R\](f:((ZZ32,ZZ32,ZZ32),T)->R): Array3[\R,b0,s0,b1,s1,b2,s2\] =
        replica[\R\]().tabulate(fn (i:ZZ32,j:ZZ32,k:ZZ32):R =>
                                    f((i,j,k),get(i-b0,j-b1,k-b2)))

    freeze():ImmutableArray[\T,(ZZ32,ZZ32,ZZ32)\] =
        fail("Freeze not defined yet!")
